customManagers.description: Track the `# renovate:`-annotated version pins in workflows and composite actions: DAV1D_VERSION (github-tags videolan/dav1d) and the Windows dav1d build tools (meson/ninja on PyPI, nasm on Chocolatey).

lockFileMaintenance.description: Refresh Cargo.lock (and other lockfiles) on a schedule so TRANSITIVE crates advance to newer compatible versions. Most of our advisory-ignore entries in deny.toml are unmaintained transitive deps (paste, ttf-parser, proc-macro-error2, quick-xml) that we cannot bump directly; keeping the lock fresh lets them drop out as their framework parents (Slint, winit, image, i18n-embed) migrate away, at which point cargo-deny's `--deny advisory-not-detected` flags the now-stale ignore for removal.

packageRules.description: Supply-chain: only adopt releases that are at least 7 days old
Group Rust crates and the Rust toolchain / cargo tools
Group linters and formatters (overrides ecosystem groups above)
Group all landing site (site/) updates: JS/TS deps, biome and the node/pnpm toolchain (overrides the rust/typescript/lint groups above)

Keep the release Linux build on ubuntu-22.04: it is deliberately the OLDEST supported runner so the AppImage and .deb link against an older glibc and install on a wider range of distros. scripts/check-release-linux-dist.sh asserts the pin. Raise it by hand, together with the README support matrix, never via Renovate.
Automerge non-major updates once every status check is green; major bumps stay manual

Keep the deliberately exact-pinned slint crates out of automerge: `unstable-winit-030` may be removed or changed in any minor release, and a behavior change there breaks drag-and-drop and window-geometry restore at runtime while every gate stays green. MUST stay after the automerge rule above — later rules win. Own group because a grouped branch automerges only if EVERY upgrade in it does.

dav1d is linked statically into every release artifact, and the macOS/Linux release recipes run only in release.yml (a dry run on the bump PR, not in CI). Group the pin and keep it out of automerge so a human confirms the release dry run before it lands. MUST stay after the automerge rule above — later rules win.
